question: Please help me find the names of top 5 players with the highest average runs per match in season 5, along with their batting averages.
sql:
-- Final query: top 5 players with highest average runs per match in season 5
-- Return player_name and batting_average (avg runs per match)
SELECT p.player_name, 
       ROUND(SUM(bs.runs_scored) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT b.match_id), 2) as batting_average
FROM ball_by_ball b
JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
JOIN player p ON p.player_id = b.striker
JOIN match m ON m.match_id = b.match_id
WHERE m.season_id = 5
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY batting_average DESC
LIMIT 5
